meta.name: Nexcybers Design System
meta.description: Core, semantic and component tokens for Nexcybers static multi-page site. All values are dark-first with light theme variant via [data-theme='light']. Semantic tokens use CSS var() aliases. Core/Spacing uses 4px multiples (4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32...). Typography uses clamp() for responsive sizing (no px hardcoding). Colors change per theme; only exception is --gold-bg and text on --gold-bg (#fff or #000 fixed). Shadows and motion easing are theme-agnostic. Component tokens organize button, card, and section styles. Layout tokens reserve max-width, gutter, and section padding. Every color complies with WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 title).

llmImplementationNotes.designSystemFlowMandatory: BEFORE any visual change: read the design guides (nexcyber-design-system.md, Nexcybers Color Palette.md, Nueva sección - guía de estructura.md). This is not optional. Understand: (1) spacing/sizing uses 4px multiples only (4,8,12,16,20,24,32...), never 14px/18px; (2) all colors via var(--token), never hardcoded hex except text on --gold-bg (#fff or #000 fixed); (3) dark/light themes must both work—test both before claiming done; (4) reuse card catalog from Sistema de diseño.md, no new variants without real need.
llmImplementationNotes.colorThemeImplementation: Site is dark-first. All color tokens in :root resolve to dark values. [data-theme='light'] block overrides with light values. --gold-bg is an exception: same value (#0091c9) in both themes because it's used as a solid fill band background, and text over it is always fixed (#fff or #000), never var(--fg). Borders (--line, --line-2) use rgba() so they automatically adjust opacity for each theme. All WCAG AA contrast verified: 4.5:1 minimum for body text, 3:1 for titles, against their actual backgrounds (dark or light).
llmImplementationNotes.spacingScale4px: All spacing, sizing, and border-radius use multiples of 4px: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 120, 160... NO exceptions like 14px margin, 18px padding, 18px border-radius. Typography (font-size) is the ONLY exception: uses clamp() with fluid breakpoints, never fixed 4px multiples. This constraint ensures visual coherence and scaling predictability.
llmImplementationNotes.buttonImplementation: Two variants only: .btn-primary (--gold background, #04222e text dark / #fff text light) and .btn-ghost (transparent bg, --line-2 border, --fg text). Both: padding 16px 28px, border-radius 100px at rest collapsing to 0 on hover/focus (the square corner is the signature interaction state, not optional). Icon arrow (.arw) slides right 4px on hover. Never invent a third color without explicit need.
llmImplementationNotes.cardCatalogReuse: Reuse existing cards from Sistema de diseño.md catalog: .trust-card, .svc, .rcard, .contact-info-card, .pil-card, .p-pair, .proc-band, .p-cmp, .about-panel, .pv-tabs. Do NOT create new card variants without first checking if content fits an existing type. New cards are documented in Sistema de diseño.md BEFORE reuse, not invented inline.
llmImplementationNotes.bandCelestContractual: Every top-level page alternates celeste band / theme band starting with celeste after hero per §2 of Nueva sección - guía de estructura.md. Celeste band implementation: background: var(--gold-bg) + ::before pseudo-element to var(--bg) + .band-lit class at opacity 0, AND add band's class (.why-band, .proc-band, .res-band, .p-band, etc.) to the IntersectionObserver selector in assets/main.js. NEVER declare own background on direct children of celeste band—celeste must show through the veil. NEVER use var(--fg) or var(--fg-soft) for text on --gold-bg: always fixed #fff or #000. This is the single exception to 'all color via variable'.
llmImplementationNotes.categoryTintColorSystem: Blog, Resources, and Product categories each get two tints (dark and light). Tints appear in .rcard (resource/blog cards): category image background, category tag, title hover. In .res-article, .ra-article (inside articles): list item markers, separator lines. In .pv-stat (product stats): badge color + icon + number. In .p-met (hover-reveal metrics): primary color of active metric. Category list is closed (not invented): 'ai' (green), 'identity' (purple), 'phishing' (orange), 'privacy' (cyan), 'risks' (red), 'reg' (same as ai), or no category (default cyan). Tints defined via [data-cat='categoryname'] selector in CSS; never hardcoded per card.
llmImplementationNotes.themeToggleBehavior: Site responds to [data-theme='light'] on <html>. All CSS custom properties update automatically. Icons (Material Symbols) scale with --gold color change. Logos swap (logo-dark / logo-light display toggle). Form inputs adjust background color (lifted at rest, down on focus). Contrast tested in both themes; text weight/size used to modulate visual hierarchy, never tonal subtlety (e.g., --fg-soft at lower opacity is incorrect; use font-weight or font-size instead).
llmImplementationNotes.typeScaleResponsive: Typography sizes use clamp() so they scale fluidly between mobile and desktop. Do NOT override with fixed font-size. Classes (.display, .h2, .h3, .lead) provide semantic meaning; use them, never font-size from scratch. .display: clamp(44px, 8.2vw, 116px) weight 800. .h2: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) weight 700. .h3: clamp(24px, 2.6vw, 32px) weight 700. .lead: clamp(20px, 2.1vw, 24px) weight 400 color --fg-soft. Eyebrow: 14px weight 400 mono letter-spacing 0.22em uppercase. Body: 16px weight 400 line-height 1.6.
llmImplementationNotes.mobileEquivalenceHover: On mobile, no :hover state. Components requiring hover reveal must provide keyboard/touch equivalent: either toggle via click (.p-met .is-open), or show revealed state by default at ≤700px breakpoint. Examples: .p-met (metrics)—number shows at rest on desktop, detail in hover; on mobile ≤700px, detail is shown by default. .proc-tab (process steps)—active tab panel on desktop desktop, all panels visible stacked on mobile ≤900px. Never hide content behind hover on touch devices.
llmImplementationNotes.paragraphFlowNoBreaks:
Body paragraphs flow freely. NO forced
inside .lead, .p-body, .svc p, descriptions, or any paragraph—layout handles wrap.
allowed ONLY in titles/headlines (.display, .h2, .h3) where line break is a typography decision. All body paragraphs must include text-wrap: pretty to avoid orphaned words. max-width in ch only in three places: hero lead (.about-hero .lead), closing CTA band (.band p, .final .lead), and footer (.foot-desc, .foot-news-p). Everything else grows with its container.
llmImplementationNotes.bgColorHierarchy: Surface colors create visual hierarchy: --bg (page base, band background), --bg-1 (card default, form inputs), --bg-2 (gradient accent in about), --panel (hover/active state of cards). --bg-1 is the workhorse card color; --panel is the state-change signal. --panel-2 reserved for future expansion. Borders use --line (subtle) and --line-2 (prominent on hover). No other background values exist; these five are the complete palette.

fontFamily.mono: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace

benefitPanelTones.note: Benefit panels section uses 5 tone backgrounds. Tones 0-3 are transitional blues; tone 4 is the standard --gold-bg (celeste).

bookASessionGreen.note: body.sec-green scope: Book a session card uses custom palette overriding --gold, --gold-soft, --cyan across dark and light themes.
